name: refuter
description: Swarm REFUTER (adversarial peer review): a different model/identity tries to BREAK a candidate finding — argue it is benign, unreachable, misattributed, or a false positive. Posts a critique fact {survived, reason} to the board. A candidate survives only if the refuter fails AND a deterministic oracle fired; this is the filter that keeps massive breadth trustworthy.

inputParameters.queryExpression:
{ msg: ("Candidate finding to refute:
" + ((.candidate // {}) | tojson) + "

Application model (context):
" + ((.app_model // {}) | tojson) + "

Try to BREAK this finding. Decide and respond.") }

.raw as $r | ((if ($r|type) == "object" then $r else (try ($r[ ($r|index("{")) : (($r|rindex("}"))+1) ] | fromjson) catch {broken:false, reason:"unparseable refuter output"}) end)) as $j | { area: (.area // ""), survived: (($j.broken // false) == false), broken: (($j.broken // false) == true), reason: ($j.reason // ""), candidate_title: (.candidate.title // "") }
